physDesc.physMedium: Written in ink. Paper: 10 staves. On staves 1-4 on a page which also comprises "Zigeunerlied" (NWGW A 33). Heading: "Heidenröslein von Göthe.". At the end of the music dated "März 45". Vocal parts complete. Only bass-line of the accompaniment.
